detections.mission_name: System Health: Payment Failure Rate by Region and Instrument
detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as txn_count, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count, 
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t
JOIN 
  users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN 
  login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
WHERE 
  t.status = 'FAILED' AND 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-45 days') AND 
  t.amount_usd > 150000
GROUP BY 
  le.country, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  failure_rate > 15

detections.sql:
SELECT le.device_type, le.device_fingerprint, le.user_agent, COUNT(le.event_id) AS login_count, 
       (COUNT(le.event_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_events WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-30 days'))) AS login_rate_percentage

JOIN users u ON le.user_id = u.user_id

SELECT u.full_name, t.instrument, t.amount, t.currency, t.status, t.created_at, le.country, le.city, a.severity, a.status, a.created_at 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id

JOIN alerts a ON u.user_id = a.user_id

AND a.severity = 'HIGH' 
AND a.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
